name: AWS Config
description: Amazon Web Services (AWS) Config provides a simple web services interface that can be used to track modifications made to the resources that belong to an AWS account. The Sumo Logic App for AWS Config presents modification notifications that contain snapshots of resource configurations and information about the modifications made to a resource.The app uses predefined Live and Interactive Dashboards and filters, which provide visibility into your environment for real-time analysis of overall usage.

panels.name: Recent Modifications
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/Config Notification ConfigurationItemChangeNotification
| json "Message", "Type" 
| where type == "Notification"
| json field=message "messageType","configurationItem" as messageType, single_message
| where messageType = "ConfigurationItemChangeNotification" 
| json field=single_message "awsRegion"
| count

panels.name: Configuration Activity by AWS Region
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/Config Notification ConfigurationItemChangeNotification
| json "Message", "Type" as single_message, type 
| where type == "Notification"
| json field=single_message "configurationItem.awsRegion" as awsRegion
| where awsRegion != "Not Applicable"
| "" as location
| if (awsRegion = "us-east-1", "38.55,-77.89", location) as location // Northern Virginia
| if (awsRegion = "us-west-1", "43.96,-121.70", location) as location // Oregon
| if (awsRegion = "us-west-2", "39.06,-121.54", location) as location // Northern California
| if (awsRegion = "us-gov-west-1", "44.34,-118.61", location) as location // ?? Also Oregon ??
| if (awsRegion = "eu-west-1", "53.31,-7.91", location) as location // Ireland
| if (awsRegion = "eu-central-1", "50.12,8.67", location) as location // Frankfurt
| if (awsRegion = "ap-southeast-1", "1.29,103.85", location) as location // Singapore
| if (awsRegion = "ap-southeast-2", "-33.85,151.15", location) as location // Sydney
| if (awsRegion = "ap-northeast-1", "35.68,139.75", location) as location // Tokyo
| if (awsRegion = "sa-east-1", "-23.57,-46.63", location) as location // Sao Paulo
| split location delim=',' extract 1 as latitude, 2 as longitude
| count by latitude, longitude
| sort _count

children.name: Most Frequently Modified Resource Types (with latest update)

search.queryText:
_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/Config Notification ConfigurationItemChangeNotification
| count by _raw, _messageTime
| json "Message", "Type" 
| where type == "Notification"
| json field=message "messageType","configurationItem" as messageType, single_message 
| where messageType = "ConfigurationItemChangeNotification" 
| json field=single_message "resourceId", "resourceType", "awsAccountId" as ResourceId, ResourceType, awsAccountId
// Use total to get the number of modifications
| 1 as row_num 
| total row_num as modifications by resourceType
// Use accum to get a row number by resource ID, and sum up the number of resource IDs for each type
| 1 as resource_num 
| accum resource_num as resource_num by resourceId 
| if (resource_num = 1, 1, 0) as resource_num 
| total resource_num as ResourcesModified by resourceType 
// Concat the data back together so we can use withtime/most_recent to find only the most recent modification
| sort by _messageTime desc 
| accum row_num as row_num by resourceType 
| where row_num = 1
// These numbers appear as floats, we want integers
| floor(Modifications) 
| floor(ResourcesModified)
// Look up Name stored in tag with key “Name” for each resource. Schedule the ‘ResourceNames Lookup Table Generator’ search to keep this file up to date.
//| lookup idAndName from /shared/AWSConfig/ResourceNames on resourceType=resourceType, resourceId=resourceId | if(isNull(idAndName), resourceId, idAndName) as ResourceId
| formatDate(_messageTime) as MostRecentModification
| fields -_raw, _messageTime
| fields(resourceType,  Modifications, ResourcesModified, MostRecentModification, awsAccountId, ResourceId)
| sort by modifications desc, resourcesModified desc

children.name: Most Frequently Modified Resources (with latest update)

search.queryText:
_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/Config Notification ConfigurationItemChangeNotification
// Accum must be used after the first grouping expression in a dashboard
| count by _raw, _messageTime
| json field=_raw "Message", "Type" 
| where type == "Notification"
| json field=message "messageType","configurationItem" as messageType, single_message 
| where messageType = "ConfigurationItemChangeNotification" 
| json field=single_message "resourceId", "resourceType", "configurationItemStatus", "awsAccountId" as ResourceId, ResourceType, LastModifiedStatus, LastModifiedAccountID
// Count the number of records per resource ID
| 1 as modifications 
| total modifications as modifications by resourceId
// Use accum as a row numbering in order to select the most recent record
| 1 as row_num 
| sort by _messageTime desc, lastmodifiedstatus asc 
| accum row_num as row_num by ResourceId 
| where row_num = 1
| formatDate(_messageTime) as LastModifiedTime 
| floor(Modifications)
| sort by modifications desc, _messageTime desc
| fields - _messageTime, _raw
// Look up Name stored in tag with key “Name” for each resource. Schedule the ‘ResourceNames Lookup Table Generator’ search to keep this file up to date.
//| lookup idAndName from /shared/AWSConfig/ResourceNames on resourceType=resourceType, resourceId=resourceId | if(isNull(idAndName), resourceId, idAndName) as resourceId | fields - idAndName
| fields resourceType, resourceId, Modifications, LastModifiedTime, LastModifiedAccountId, LastModifiedStatus

panels.name: Resource Modifications
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/Config Notification ConfigurationItemChangeNotification 
| json "Message", "Type" 
| where type == "Notification" 
| json field=message "messageType","configurationItem", "configurationItemDiff", "configurationItem.relatedEvents" as messageType, single_message, diff, cloudtrail_events
| where messageType = "ConfigurationItemChangeNotification" 
| json field=single_message "resourceId", "resourceType", "configurationItemStatus", "awsAccountId", "awsRegion" 
| if (configurationItemStatus matches "Resource*", configurationItemStatus, diff) as Details
| count by _messageTime, AWSAccountID, awsRegion, ResourceId, ResourceType, cloudtrail_events, Details
| sort by _messageTime desc 
| formatDate(_messageTime) as Time 
| fields -_messageTime, _count 
| fields Time, AWSAccountID, awsRegion, ResourceType, ResourceId,Cloudtrail_events, Details

panels.name: Resource Relationships
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/Config Notification ConfigurationItemChangeNotification
| count by _raw, _messageTime
| json "Message", "Type" 
| where type == "Notification"
| json field=message "messageType","configurationItem" as messageType, single_message 
| where messageType = "ConfigurationItemChangeNotification" 
| json field=single_message "resourceId", "resourceType", "configurationItemStatus", "awsAccountId", "awsRegion", "relationships" nodrop
| 1 as row_num 
| sort by _messageTime desc, configurationItemStatus asc 
| accum row_num as row_num by ResourceId 
| where row_num = 1
// If the most recent record is 'Deleted', the resource has been deleted and we do not want to display any "current" relationships
| where configurationItemStatus != "ResourceDeleted"
// Split out each relationship into a record
| parse regex field=relationships "(?<single_relationship>\{\"resourceId\"\:.*?\})((?=,\{\"resourceId\")|(?=\]\s*$))" multi
| json field=single_relationship "resourceId", "name", "resourceType" as relatedResourceId, relationship, relatedResourceType
| sort by resourceType asc, resourceId asc, relationship asc, relatedResourceType asc, relatedResourceId asc 
| fields - _raw, _messageTime
| fields (awsAccountId, awsRegion, resourceType, resourceId, relationship, relatedResourceType, relatedResourceId)

panels.name: Resource Tags
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/Config Notification ConfigurationItemChangeNotification
| count by _raw, _messageTime
| json "Message", "Type" as single_message, messageType 
| where messageType == "Notification" 
| json field=single_message "messageType","configurationItem" as messageType, single_message 
| where messageType = "ConfigurationItemChangeNotification" 
| json field=single_message "resourceId", "resourceType", "configurationItemStatus", "awsAccountId", "awsRegion" 
| json field=single_message "configuration.tags" as tags
| 1 as row_num | sort by _messageTime desc 
| accum row_num as row_num by resourceId 
| where row_num = 1
| parse regex field=tags "(?<single_tag>\{\"value\"\:.*?\})((?=,\{\"value\")|(?=\]\s*$))" multi
| json field=single_tag "value", "key" as Value, Tag
| sort by ResourceType asc, ResourceId asc, Tag asc
| fields -_count, _raw, _messageTime, single_message, messageType, tags, single_tag, row_num, _some_matched, configurationItemStatus
| fields awsAccountId, awsRegion, resourceType, resourceId, tag, Value

panels.name: Network ACL Rules
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/Config Notification ConfigurationItemChangeNotification
// Accum must be used after the first grouping expression in a dashboard
| count by _raw, _messageTime
| json field=_raw "Message", "Type" 
| where type == "Notification"
| json field=message "messageType","configurationItem" as messageType, single_message 
| where messageType = "ConfigurationItemChangeNotification" 
| json field=single_message "resourceId", "resourceType", "configurationItemStatus", "awsAccountId", "awsRegion", "configuration.entries" as ResourceId, ResourceType, Status, AWSAccountID, AWSRegion, Entries nodrop
// Select only the correct resource type for this dashboard
| where resourceType = "AWS::EC2::NetworkAcl" 
// Use accum as a row numbering in order to select the most recent record
| 1 as row_num 
| sort by _messageTime desc, status asc 
| accum row_num as row_num by ResourceId 
| where row_num = 1
// If the most recent record is 'Deleted', the resource has been deleted and we do not want to display any "current" relationships
| where Status != "ResourceDeleted"
// Split out each ACL Rule into a record
| parse regex field=entries "(?<single_entry>\{\"egress\"\:.*?\})((?=,\{\"egress\")|(?=\]\s*$))" multi
| json field=single_entry "ruleNumber", "ruleAction", "protocol", "egress", "cidrBlock" as RuleNumber, Action, Protocol, Egress, CIDRBlock
| sort by _messageTime desc, resourceId desc, RuleNumber desc 
| fields - _raw, _messageTime
| fields awsregion, awsAccountId, resourceId, RuleNumber, Action, Protocol, Egress, CIDRBlock

children.name: ResourceNames Lookup Table Generator

search.queryText:
_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/Config Notification ConfigurationItemChangeNotification
| json "Message", "Type" 
| where type == "Notification"
| json field=message "messageType","configurationItem" as messageType, single_message 
| where messageType = "ConfigurationItemChangeNotification" 
| json field=single_message "resourceId", "resourceType", "configurationItemStatus", "tags.Name" as ResourceId, ResourceType, Status, Name nodrop
// Use accum as a row numbering in order to select the most recent record
| 1 as row_num 
| sort by _messageTime desc, status asc 
| accum row_num as row_num by ResourceId 
| where row_num = 1 | fields - row_num
| concat (" | ", Name, " ") as idAndName 
| if(idAndName matches " | * ", "", idAndName) as idAndName
| concat (resourceId, idAndName) as idAndName
| count by resourceId, resourceType, idAndName 
| fields - _count
| save append /Shared/AWSConfig/ResourceNames

children.description: Run or schedule this search on a regular basis to generate the ResourceNames lookup table.
